Name: OpenECG codec_v6 frame segmenter
Summary: Single-lead network emitting per-sample none/P/QRS/T logits plus beat and rhythm heads.

x-mival.notes: unverified: sha256 of the packaged files (codec_v6.pt 4.9 MB; codec_v6_int8.onnx sha256 starts 640d2d13), python version. No paper; README and openecg/models/codec_v6_MODEL_CARD.md only. Apache-2.0. Weights ship inside the PyPI package. ONNX output batch fixed at 1. Rank normalisation to [-1, 1] per window is not an existing scaling. Ran on LUDB record 1 lead II with sensible P/QRS/T runs (search 2026-10-06). x-mival.output is the nearest existing value and is wrong in meaning: 4 classes per sample, not per record.

per_lead.apply_to: each lead independently (benchmarks use lead II)

decode.intervals: openecg.report() -> pr, qrs_duration, qt in ms
